item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell declined to answer questions from a House committee, citing 5th Amendment rights
item.description: Lawmakers tried Monday to interview Ghislaine Maxwell, but the former girlfriend and confidante of Jeffrey Epstein invoked her 5th Amendment rights to avoid answering questions that would be incriminating.

item.title: Olympians who got COVID in 2022 are using masks, sanitizer and vitamins for the Milan Games
item.description: Figure skater Amber Glenn didn’t even get the chance to try to qualify for the 2022 U.S. Olympic team because she tested positive for COVID-19. Clearly, that sticks with her.

item.title: Two Team USA locals fall just short of speed skating 1000m podium
item.description: Salt Lake City residents Erin Jackson and Brittany Bowe led Team USA into the Speed Skating Women’s 1000m event on Monday, and both finished with top times just outside of the top three.

item.title: Senator asks Campus Safety Task Force to consider expenses and practicality when making recomendations
item.description: The Utah System of Higher Education Campus Safety Task Force updated the legislature on what they are doing to make Universities safer after Charlie Kirk was shot and killed at Utah Valley University.

item.title: Utah County leaders ask state lawmakers for $2 million to help with Tyler Robinson case
item.description: Utah County leaders are now asking state lawmakers for $2 million in taxpayer money to help with the costs associated with the Tyler Robinson case.

item.title: Former SLC fire battalion chief arrested, accused of having hundreds of child sex abuse images
item.description: A former Salt Lake City Fire Department division chief was arrested on suspicion of sexual exploitation of a minor.

item.title: Teenager shot, 2 teens arrested in gang-related shooting in Kearns
item.description: A teenager was shot after a fight at a Kearns park on Sunday, police said. Two more teens were arrested, and police said it was a gang-related incident.

item.title: Clinton City is hoping for an economic comeback
item.description: Businesses along one of Clinton City's main thoroughfares have been struggling amid years of major road construction.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie makes new video plea as missing mother’s ransom deadline nears
item.description: Savannah Guthrie said in a video released Monday that her family is “at an hour of desperation” is the search for the “Today” show host's missing mother.

item.title: New, less invasive, fetal surgery at Primary Children’s improves outcomes for babies with spina bifida
item.description: Doctors at Intermountain Health Primary Children’s Hospital said a new, less invasive, fetal surgery procedure is helping treat spina bifida while babies are still in the womb
